answer: The oasis is the public book of sureties: every identity needs an established sponsor who locks an ivory bond there, the sponsor's first bond $100, the second $200, the third $300, so the k-th identity costs k times $100. A proven fake forfeits its bond and turns its sponsor's seal violet, barring that sponsor from new bonds for a year. Splitting needs fresh established sponsors, each risking the same stain. Forging 1,000 puppets through one sponsor locks $100 x (1+2+...+1000) = $50,050,000, while an honest user needs one sponsor and one $100 bond, refunded after a clean year.
